root_cause_criterion.criterion: After `UA_free(dst->data)` on the error path, the helper must clear `dst->data` before returning so generic Variant cleanup cannot reuse the freed body pointer.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable run frees the unwrapped body buffer and returns with `dst->data` still equal to that freed pointer. The fixed run reaches the same cleanup branch but leaves `dst->data` as NULL instead.

nodes.state: `NodeId_clear()` consumes the stale `authenticationToken` node-id pointer as its `p` argument, so `switch(p->identifierType)` is the ASan-reported use-after-free read.

edges.relation: The pointer freed in `Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject()` is later reused as the first `UA_clear((void*)ptr, type)` element pointer inside `UA_Array_delete()` during generic cleanup.
That same stale element pointer becomes the `p` argument of the first `clearStructure()` call that clears the freed `CreateSubscriptionRequest` object.
The first `clearStructure()` call advances to the freed `RequestHeader` first-member subobject and immediately recurses into a second `clearStructure()` on that same member pointer.
The second `clearStructure()` call advances to the freed `authenticationToken` member and passes that exact node-id pointer to `NodeId_clear()`.
